scheme_name: Shop Construction/Shop Operation Scheme For Rehabilitation Of PwDs
other_conditions: Certificate of minimum 40% disability issued by Chief Medical Officer or Doctor of Community Health Centre/Primary Health Centre (valid)
Applicant must be a citizen of Uttar Pradesh
Applicant must not be convicted in any criminal or financial matters and must have no outstanding government dues
Applicant must own or be able to acquire at least 110 sq. ft. of land for shop construction
Tenant must be given a lease tenure of 5 years for shop operation (rent and working capital)
Annual income must not exceed twice the income limit prescribed by the government from time to time to the poverty line
benefits_summary: Provides up to Rs. 20,000 for shop establishment (Rs. 15,000 loan @4% + Rs. 5,000 grant) and up to Rs. 10,000 for shop operation (Rs. 7,500 loan @4% + Rs. 2,500 grant).
documents_required: Certificate of minimum 40% disability (issued by Chief Medical Officer or Doctor of Community Health Centre/Primary Health Centre)
